newsitem.title: USA: US to sell $8 bln of 5-yr indexed notes July 9.
newsitem.headline: US to sell $8 bln of 5-yr indexed notes July 9.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Wednesday that it will sell $8 billion of 5-year inflation-indexed notes on July 9 to raise cash.
It is the Treasury's first auction of five-year notes that carry the inflation protection feature. It sold 10-year indexed notes in January and in April.
The notes, to be sold in a single-price auction format, will be issued on July 15. They mature on July 15, 2002.
The CUSIP number for the notes will be 9128273A8.
